paragraphs: The XM Label is the top-tier variant of BMW's first standalone M-only model since the original M1 in 1978. It uses the S68B44T0 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 hybrid producing 738hp combined (577hp from the ICE alone). This is a substantially re-engineered unit compared to its S63 predecessor, with a new crankshaft, oil cooler, oil sump, upgraded turbochargers, and BMW's first electric VANOS system. Only the displacement and hot-vee layout carry over from the earlier engine. The XM Label and XM Label Red are mechanically identical — Label Red is specifically a limited-edition 500-unit run of the same specification.
about.boldParagraph: The XM Label is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
